features.description: Scheduler: lay tasks into free gaps around fixed events, in priority order; unplaceable tasks become overflow; never shrink tasks; fixed events never move
steps: Given a 09:00-17:00 day, a 12:00-13:00 event and 30/60/90 min tasks, tasks are placed in order in free gaps without overlapping the event
A task longer than every remaining gap lands in overflow with its duration unchanged
Fixed events are returned at their original times

features.description: Re-flow after extension: extending the running task by N min shifts later tasks by N, respecting fixed events, with overflow if the day runs out
steps: Extending the current task +15 moves every later task 15 min later
A later task that would collide with a fixed event jumps to the next gap
Tasks that no longer fit appear as overflow

features.description: Estimate learning: per-category median(actual/estimate) multiplier from >=3 sessions, snapped suggestion to 15-min blocks
steps: With <3 sessions in a category no suggestion is produced
With 3 sessions of ratios 1.5,2,1 the multiplier is 1.5 and a 60 min estimate suggests 90
Categories are independent

features.description: Parsers: .ics fixed-event import and CSV time-log import (date,task,category,estimate_min,actual_min,extended_min,distracted,energy_1to5,note)
steps: An .ics with two VEVENTs on one day yields two fixed events with correct minutes
A CSV in the specified columns yields session records; quoted commas and bad rows are handled without crashing
Malformed input returns an error list, not an exception

features.description: Persistence in IndexedDB: tasks, events, sessions, active-timer state survive reload
steps: Save then reopen the DB: data is identical
Active timer state restores with correct elapsed time after simulated reload

features.description: Plan screen: add tasks (title, category, 15/30/60/90 estimate, optional reward), import .ics, see day timeline with overflow section
steps: Add 5 tasks and import an .ics; timeline shows them in gaps
Overflow shown separately when the day is full
Works at 375px with no horizontal scroll

features.description: Focus session: big countdown for the block plus stopwatch of real time; start/pause
steps: Start shows countdown and elapsed counting
Pause stops both
Reload mid-session restores the timer

features.description: Check-in at block end: Done / +15 / +30 / Stuck-switch, then Break 5-10 or Skip break; plan re-flows immediately; reward reminder shown
steps: At block end the check-in appears
+15 shifts later tasks 15 min
Done logs a session and shows the task's reward if set

features.description: Keyboard shortcuts: Space start/pause, D done, E extend
steps: Space toggles timer
D completes the task
E extends 15 min

features.description: Stats page: estimate-vs-actual by category, focus minutes per day, streak, adjusted-estimate suggestion at task creation
steps: After 3 sessions in a category the ratio is shown
New task in that category shows the suggestion with accept/override
Streak counts consecutive days with a session

features.description: Import CSV time log and export all data as JSON/CSV in one click
steps: Importing the sample CSV adds sessions
Export downloads a file containing all tasks, events, sessions

features.description: Installable offline PWA: manifest + service worker
steps: Manifest valid with icons
After first load the app loads with network disabled

features.description: Accessibility and responsive pass: axe has zero critical/serious violations; usable at 375px
steps: axe run on main screens reports none
No horizontal scroll at 375px
